about: sgx has no /dev/kvm, so Kata cannot run there or on the hub's host. This is a genuine QEMU q35 guest (TCG) booted on sgx inside a disposable container, with Alpine's linux-virt kernel and the probe as init — the machine type and firmware tables a Kata-qemu guest presents. Captured 2026-10-17 (Task 20439).
